brief:
Kosovo officially joined President Donald Trump's so-called Board of Peace and the International Stabilisation initiative on Monday following Israeli approval, according to Middle East Eye. The move has drawn criticism from observers who point to the contradiction between Kosovo's historical reliance on international law for its own survival and its current support for a framework critics say enables Israel to circumvent international legal constraints in Gaza.

Kosovo's decision reflects pressure from the United States and its regional partners on smaller nations to align with American diplomatic initiatives. The country faced similar geopolitical calculations when it sought international recognition after declaring independence.

title: Kosovo backs Trump's Middle East plan despite international law concerns
